seo_title_en: UFA169 and Similar Names Understanding Website Identity
meta_description_en: Similar names and logos do not establish ownership or endorsement. Learn to separate publishers, external links and sources through fictional sports examples.
actual_intent_served: Informational media literacy: why repeated names, logos, and domain text do not establish common ownership, endorsement, or the provenance of a claim.
editorial_note_en: English adaptation of the Thai media-literacy draft. The fictional publication and club are rendered as Neighbourhood Pitch and Morning Star Football Club. No actual operator, affiliation, licensing, legitimacy, or safety claim is made. The article does not help readers select a gambling provider. No independent originality check, publication, or ranking outcome is claimed.

sources.supports_en: General impersonation examples involving logos, names, and lookalike addresses.
